result.summary: The page layout is mostly sound, but the first card in the 'Popular right now' section has a failed/missing image, leaving a large empty grey placeholder with a broken-image glyph. Related styling on that card's overlay controls also suffers from the missing image.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in 'Popular right now' shows no photo — only a blank light-grey block with a broken-image icon, unlike every other restaurant card which has artwork.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/loading for this restaurant and add a branded fallback (e.g. cuisine illustration or logo with restaurant initials) instead of exposing a raw broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: Because the image is missing, the favourite (heart) button on the Tokumaru card renders as a grey circle with a white outline on a near-identical light grey background, giving very low contrast compared with the dark heart button on the pizza card below.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent high-contrast treatment for the favourite button (e.g. solid dark or white circle with shadow) that is independent of the underlying image.

issues.description: The empty image container on the Tokumaru card is quite tall relative to its now-empty content, creating a large stretch of dead grey space that visually breaks the rhythm of the list.
issues.suggestion: Ensure placeholder blocks fill the aspect ratio with a subtle pattern or skeleton shimmer so the space reads as intentional loading state rather than an error.
